suite: every study opens in 3D showing only its parts
expect_red: [real] ...and ticking it again draws every one of them back

mutations.contract: Every part is translucent until an action names it, and a hidden body draws nothing (handoff everything_in_3d_is_transparent_until_an_action_needs_a_face).
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff everything_in_3d_is_transparent_until_an_action_needs_a_face (2026-11-05). Hiding reaches every part's copy; showing does not, so the copies stay gone.
mutations.replace: for (const sha of this.parts.keys()) if (!visible) this._applyVisibility(sha);
